title: Stentorophonic
summary: STENTOROPHONIC, adjective [from Stentor, a herald in Homer, whose voice was as loud as that of fifty other men, and Gr., voice.] Speaking or sounding very loud. Of this stentorophonic horn of Alexande

inlines.v: STENTOROPHONIC, adjective [from Stentor, a herald in Homer, whose voice was as loud as that of fifty other men, and Gr., voice.] Speaking or sounding very loud. Of this stentorophonic horn of Alexander there is a figure preserved in the Vatican.
